set.body:
Source: approved ergonomic remote-task example after P6f.17.

Problem:
Slurm.overSsh now exposes a truthful RemoteSlurm facade, and SlurmTask supports compact calls, but the agent protocol still accepts only ExitOnly scripts. There is no honest remote submit(Increment(41)) or await/reattach path.

Acceptance:
- Add an owned, versioned registered-task request/response wire dialect; no derived case-name discriminators and no boxed-byte JSON arrays.
- Stage invocations with RegisteredTaskLauncher on the target host; never serialize closures or IO values.
- Return an agent-issued durable result reference plus SubmissionAttempt without collapsing acceptance uncertainty.
- Add bounded result-envelope reads and client-side schema/release/epoch/output validation.
- Expose RemoteSlurm.submit(taskCall, options) returning a reconnectable typed handle.
- The handle offers await: F[RemoteExecutionResult[A]]; awaitValue is explicit opt-in convenience and preserves diagnostics in its typed exception.
- Pin protocol fixtures and prove loopback SSH parity, disconnect/reattach, oversized-result, rejected submission, OOM/timeout, and stale-epoch behavior.

Prerequisites:
agent request containment, honest frame/log encoding, sacct array/accounting correctness, environment-name validation, and event delivery decoupled from result authority.
set.title: P6f.27: Add remote registered-task submission and typed result handles
